mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0% over 3 months, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which signals an impending recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 950.0 and RSAFS < 370000.0 in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 in two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a collapse in private demand, which triggers a flight to safety and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 365000.0 and HOUST < 930.0 in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 65% of triggered cases, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over a 3-month period signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals a labor market breakdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 137000.0 and UNRATE > 6.0% in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth, combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO), signals a deepening economic slowdown, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1.0 and INDPRO < 100.0 in the same quarter
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate negative 60-day returns in more than 65% of triggered cases, or the combined effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression framework.
